artist.name: AAGUU
artist.bio: Aashish Gupta performs as AAGUU. He grew up in Bengaluru, moved to Berlin in 2018 and now lives in Goa. He was one half of the duo TechNomads, and his debut came in 2019 through Todh Teri's Deep in India series. He played Magnetic Fields in 2023.

eras.sound: Groovy psychedelia blended with fluid body music
